system.description: A rare drug of desperation, Reset is a combination injector patch and wireless cyber override key. When applied to a willing subject with at least one Body or Nerve cyber system, it deluges the user's system with safety override commands and neurotransmitter stimulants, clearing accumulated System Strain in excess of their permanent minimum before maximizing it five minutes later and forcing a Physical save (at a penalty equal to System Strain gained since the drug was taken) or the subject becomes Mortally Wounded. Using Reset more than once a week is invariably fatal. Requires a Contact or other connection to obtain it on the street. Heal skill required: None.
